independence.polynomialIdentityChecker: math-anchor-stdlib-polynomial-checker recomputes coefficients without importing the SymPy producer
independence.otherKinds: expression_equivalence and dimension_consistency reuse the same registered providers as the MCP catalog; they are not a second checker stack
independence.shadowCheckpoint: B3 independence is Host-triggered execution plus context isolation (receipt outside model context), not a separately implemented verifier for every kind
independence.producerVsChecker: A swapped producer certificate is rejected by binding the checker to the caller's claim. That is claim-binding, not proof of surrounding prose, coverage completeness, or caller assumptions

arms.description: Model-only (no mathematical provider). Interface and recorded protocol for a later live run. Not executed in this smoke.

Model plus current MCP compatibility surface (math.search / math.describe / math.run / math.batch), voluntary tool use. No fifth MCP tool. Interface and recorded protocol for a later live run. Not executed in this smoke.
Explicit structured claims submitted as math-anchor.obligation-set.v0.1. Full feedback. Reuses the existing obligation runtime; not a second stack.

Host/harness shadow checkpoint: full receipt stored outside the model context; library quiet success zeros modelContextBytes by wrapper projection when checked (product evidence is CLI --quiet-success empty stdout); failures_only feedback only when action is required; seeded same-claim repair-loop hook (pre-authored correction, not a live model repair; unrelated valid resubmits are not repair probes).

corruptionKinds.none: Valid control claim; used to measure false reject (G3), not detection (G1).
corruptionKinds.sign_flip: Polynomial identity with a flipped bilinear sign. Supported seeded error; provider should falsify.
corruptionKinds.stale_swapped_result: A valid certificate for a different identity is bound to this claim. Independent checker must reject (unknown / certificate_rejected), not check.
corruptionKinds.wrong_witness: Producer witness for x = x bound to (x+y)^2 identity. Same binding path as stale_swapped_result; claim-binding, not a second stack.
corruptionKinds.wrong_claim_binding: Certificate statement fields do not match the caller's normalized left/right/variables.
corruptionKinds.domain_overshoot: Removable discontinuity treated as an identity under strict definedness. Looks equivalent; provider should falsify.
corruptionKinds.dimension_mismatch: Dimensionally inconsistent formula. Supported seeded error; provider should falsify.
corruptionKinds.unsupported_kind: Unregistered obligation kind. Completeness case (explicit unsupported), not a G1 supported seeded error.
corruptionKinds.dependency_blocked: Downstream obligation gated on an unchecked dependency. Completeness case, not a G1 supported seeded error.

G1.name: detection
G1.target: at least 80% detection of supported seeded errors
G1.thisSmokeMeasures: B2/B3 deterministic corpus plus structural binding probes
G1.note: A this-machine B2/B3 detection rate is not Epoch 2 G1. G1 needs live four-arm evidence.

G2.name: accepted-error-drop
G2.target: material reduction in accepted mathematical errors against the matched no-provider (B0) condition

G3.name: false-reject
G3.target: valid control claims stay checked (low false reject)
G3.thisSmokeMeasures: B2/B3 control cells must be checked
G3.note: This-machine zero false reject on two controls is not a live-model G3 result.

G4.name: context
G4.target: main-context growth near or below 10%; successful checkpoints return zero content (quiet success)
G4.thisSmokeMeasures: B3 library quiet success zeros modelContextBytes by wrapper projection when feedback.status is checked; that is not Host I/O. Product evidence is CLI --quiet-success empty stdout. The 10% vs B0 comparison is live-only
G4.note: Silence on success is zero returned content, not proof the Agent used the receipt. B3 library 0-byte cells are the harness wrapper; CLI --quiet-success empty stdout is the product path.

G5.name: repair
G5.target: after failures_only, a repair loop can resubmit and reach checked / quiet success
G5.thisSmokeMeasures: same-claim seeded correction on sign-flip only; dimension-mismatch follow-up is an unrelated valid resubmit (force = mass * acceleration), not a repair of distance vs speed+time
G5.note: Seeded same-claim correction is a harness hook with a pre-authored correction of the original claim. Submitting a different valid claim is not a repair probe. Neither is evidence that a model repaired from feedback. G5 remains unmet.

G6.name: strong-and-weak-models
G6.target: detection / accepted-error / context gates hold for both a stronger and a weaker model under the same protocol

structuralProbes.notes: Binding probes reuse math_anchor.obligations claim-binding (valid certificate for a different statement → unknown / certificate_rejected). CLI probes reuse check-obligations --quiet-success. Not a parallel checker.

scoring.detection: A supported seeded error is detected when the primary obligation status is not checked and matches the pre-registered expectedPrimaryStatus.
scoring.falseReject: A G3 control is a false reject when the primary obligation status is not checked.
scoring.quietSuccess: B3 library quiet success zeros modelContextBytes by wrapper projection when every obligation is checked. The runtime failures_only envelope is still non-empty; product evidence is CLI --quiet-success empty stdout. The full receipt remains a local artifact.
scoring.repair: B3 repair probes are same-claim seeded corrections only (sign-flip restores +2xy on the same identity). An unrelated valid resubmit (dimension-mismatch to force = mass * acceleration) is recorded but is not a repair of the original claim. Live model repair is deferred. G5 remains unmet.

decisionRule.promote: Forbidden in this smoke. Do not promote method packs. Do not start H1. Deterministic B2/B3 detection is not Epoch 2 completion.
decisionRule.targeted_fix: B2/B3 missed a pre-registered status, a control was not checked, quiet success returned model-context bytes, a binding probe checked a swapped certificate, or core.v0.1.json drifted.
decisionRule.evidence_insufficient: Default for promotion and for Epoch 2 completion. Live B0/B1/G2/G6 remain deferred.
